categories.main_business_segments: SF Oilless Bearing Group Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of sliding bearings, composite materials for sliding bearings, and copper powder. Its product portfolio includes SF series bearings, JF series bearings, JDB series bearings, FU series bearings, composite materials, and hydraulic parts. The company serves various industries such as automotive manufacturing, engineering machinery, hydraulic systems, mold manufacturing, marine industry, new energy, aerospace, and rail transit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced composite materials technology, including metal-nonmetal and metal-metal layered composite bearings, friction welding, and powder metallurgy. It has developed proprietary self-lubricating materials and automated production equipment such as mechanical arms and friction wear testing machines. The manufacturing process emphasizes automation, precision, and quality control, supported by certifications like ISO9001 and IATF16949.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span automotive OEMs, engineering machinery manufacturers, hydraulic pump producers, mold makers, and sectors like new energy, wind power, and robotics. The company maintains long-term stable relationships with major clients including MISUMI, CCVISPA, XCMG, SANY, China National Heavy Duty Truck Group, and Japanese Showa. Its products are increasingly accepted in international markets including Europe, the US, and Japan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Zhejiang Province, particularly Jiaxing and Jiaxing's Jiashan County. It also has subsidiaries in Sichuan and Jinhua. Export sales account for about 20% of revenue, serving over 40 countries and regions globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: SF Group operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing sliding bearings and related composite materials. It controls the production of key raw materials such as copper powder through its subsidiary Jinhua Shuangfei Chengkai Alloy Materials Co., Ltd., integrating upstream supply with downstream bearing production and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in materials science, aiming to improve wear resistance, lubrication, and durability of sliding bearings. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on new materials for automotive transmissions, wind power gearboxes, and robotics. Strategic plans include enhancing automation, digital management, international market expansion, and talent development to maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of sliding bearings, composite materials, copper powder, and hydraulic parts. The company employs a predominantly direct sales model domestically and a mix of direct and distributor sales internationally. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SF Group is one of the largest and leading sliding bearing manufacturers in China, holding a dominant position in the domestic market. It competes with other domestic and international bearing manufacturers, leveraging its advanced technology, comprehensive product range, and strong brand recognition. The company is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a leader in sliding bearing standardization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 848.7 million, a 12.7% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 67.37 million, up 15.8%. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.28 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company maintains steady growth with increasing R&D investment accounting for over 6% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SF Group emphasizes its proprietary self-lubricating composite materials and advanced manufacturing technologies that extend bearing life and performance under harsh conditions. Its products are designed for high reliability in environments where lubrication is difficult, such as high temperature, high pressure, and corrosive media. The company’s integrated supply chain, strong R&D capabilities, and customized solutions provide competitive advantages in quality, cost, and delivery.
